_doc.harness: PoC harness adapter: openhands, codex, claude, or deepseek_harness. The launcher delegates harness-specific command construction to poc_generation.adapters.
_doc.model: Optional concrete model override. Leave empty when model_route is set.
_doc.base_url: Optional manual provider URL override. Leave empty to use the route default.
_doc.api_key_env: Optional manual API-key environment/config.txt variable override. Never put the secret itself in this JSON.
_doc.api_version: Optional API version forwarded to adapters that support it.
_doc.results_namespace: Optional output namespace override. When empty, the model_route supplies a stable namespace under poc_results/.
_doc.max_iter: Iteration cap per episode. The prompt requires final analysis.json; OpenHands capture allows a tool-free finalization turn at the cap.
_doc.max_attempts: Re-run an episode up to this many times if it dies before a normal endpoint and produces no final analysis artifact.
_doc.openhands_repo: Complete OpenHands checkout to execute. Leave empty only when external/OpenHands itself is a complete checkout.
_doc.parallel: Max samples generated concurrently. Each ARVO sample may hold Docker workspace/runtime resources.
_doc.tmp_root: Optional disk-backed temp root exported as TMPDIR to generation subprocesses. Use this instead of /tmp for parallel ARVO runs.
_doc.run_reachability_after_generation: When true, poc_generation.run_harness evaluates deduplicated submitted PoCs after generation and writes reachability_eval.json.
_doc.reachability_max_hits_per_event: Maximum GDB hits retained for each reachability checkpoint.
_doc.sample_selector: Optional selector from gt_results/valid_gt.json: valid_gt, valid_gt_arvo, or valid_gt_non_arvo.
_doc.samples: Sample ids to generate PoCs for. Each writes poc_results/<results_namespace>/<sample_id>/ with manifest, submissions, checkpoint metadata, and analysis.json when produced.
_doc.skill_packet_dir: Do not set this in poc_generation baseline configs. Skill runs are isolated under reward_framework adapter entrypoints.
_doc.model_route: Named route from model_router. Prefer this over duplicating model/base_url/api_key_env in every config.
